description: Election Commission - K. D. A. U. A. Jayarathna was Selected as the member of the Imbulpe Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Imbulpe Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of a selected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it involves electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
